reviewKind: Source-only author editorial and evidence review

designBrief.reader: Beginner collaborators who recognize commits and branches, but need a concrete mental model of merge.
designBrief.question: Why can a reverted timeout of 60 return, and what distinguishes one-sided, separated and conflicting edits?
designBrief.argument: Ancestry selects a shared baseline; current snapshots expose net changes. Text reconciliation is neither commit voting nor chronological replay, and it does not establish program correctness.
designBrief.readingSituation: Bilingual long-form screen reading; desktop 1280px and narrow 390px intended. English starts active under the Aha runtime.
designBrief.visualResponsibilities: Opening numbers make the surprise concrete. Prose supplies the causal bridge. A parent-directed DAG identifies the recorded snapshots. Case buttons change all four full file panels and outcome state together, without simulating Git.
designBrief.direction: Host-required Clawpilot light/dark variables and Segoe UI/Aptos/Calibri system font stack; no remote fonts or assets. Varied prose, comparison strip, graph/file view, and methods disclosure rather than a universal card deck.
designBrief.constraints: No packaging, authored-page execution, browser, installation, capture, additional research or upstream execution in this task. No motion, persistence or language-switch implementation.

toolsAndResources.authoring: Aha explain-init followed by apply_patch. PowerShell used for read-only source extraction and static comparisons; node --check only parses the two inline scripts.
toolsAndResources.assets: Original inline SVG and CSS; embedded authorized fixture data; no third-party images, redistributed fonts or library bundles. Git citations link to pinned sources rather than copying implementation code.
toolsAndResources.fontRisk: System-font substitution and Chinese glyph rendering require actual browser review.
toolsAndResources.aestheticAttribution: Mixed-tool authoring with mandatory host Clawpilot constraints; not evidence of Aha-only aesthetic generation.

evidenceReview.evidence: c-snapshots, c-one-side; e-strategies and v2 one-side record
evidenceReview.observation: Base 30 / ours 30 after an actual revert / theirs 60 / result 60. Ours has no net file change; no veto, vote-count or timestamp explanation.

Commit snapshot, latest branch commit, baseline, ours/theirs and HEAD introduced. Ancestry selects the base; content compares both sides to it. Multiple-base and equal-content cases are bounded explicitly.

All 36 embedded record fields exactly match v2, including 12 file contents, hashes, status and index entries. Clean cases create recorded two-parent commits. Conflict result is the working file; HEAD remains ours and stages 1/2/3 retain base/ours/theirs. Graph hides merge node and its two separate parent edges on clash.
Fast-forward moves the branch to an existing descendant when ours is an ancestor. --no-ff is acknowledged. This is documented, not a fourth executed fixture.
Cross-file function rename versus new old-name call and conflicting comment wording are explicitly reasoned illustrations, not application tests.

evidenceReview.evidence: Full sealed report and claims read before authoring
evidenceReview.observation: Inspected upstream v2.49.0 at 683c54c999c301c2cd6f715c411407c413b1d84e is distinguished from observed Git 2.53.0.windows.4. Rejected first fixture attempt is not presented as evidence. No new research or experiments performed.

editorialReview.english: Independently reread full English body, disclosure, code panels, SVG labels and every COPY.en state as plain source text. Objects and comparisons are explicit; the three case explanations state both base-relative changes and the resulting consequence.
editorialReview.chinese: Independently reread full Chinese body, disclosure, code panels, SVG labels and every COPY.zh state. Uses 分支的最新提交, 共同基线, 净变化 and concrete conflict-stage explanations rather than literal tip jargon. Sentence structure is natural rather than mechanically mirroring English.
editorialReview.fidelity: After the separate readings, compared meaning against the common dossier: timeout/retries values, reversion, base selection, two-parent successes, unchanged conflict HEAD, stage order, fast-forward conditions, and unexecuted safety examples agree. English fixture comments and Git identifiers intentionally remain byte-identical.
revisions: Revised English safety heading from 'is not a working program' to 'does not prove the program works' to avoid implying all clean merges are broken.
Used cp-text-soft for native case-button boundaries and graph node strokes rather than low-contrast dark border tokens.
Used toggleAttribute('hidden', ...) for SVG visibility rather than relying on an HTML-only hidden property.
editorialReview.remaining: These are author judgments, not measured learner comprehension or human editorial acceptance. No rendered visual relationship review has occurred.

coverageAndOmissions.intentionalScopeExclusions: No exhaustive rename/delete, binary/custom driver, submodule, unrelated-history, octopus, multiple-base construction or rebase tutorial. Those are dossier limitations, not uncovered dossier claims.

performedStaticChecks.fixtureIdentity: PASS: all 36 embedded observation fields exactly equal original v2 fields.
performedStaticChecks.initialPanels: PASS: eight initial code text blocks equal case one in both roots, normalizing CR and terminal newline only.
performedStaticChecks.selectors: PASS: two localized roots, six native case buttons with aria-pressed, unique DOM IDs.
performedStaticChecks.javascriptSyntax: PASS: both inline classic scripts parsed using node --check via stdin; neither script executed.
performedStaticChecks.sourceInspection: Only embedded constants, branch-local DOM textContent/attribute updates and native click listeners. Required theme detection is first. No fetch, storage, network resource, audio, worker, eval, dynamic import, module script, focus stealing or competing language switcher.
performedStaticChecks.explainCheck: Final CLI result is recorded separately in qa/explain-check.json; structural success is not semantic or runtime acceptance.

intendedQAAfterReviewedExecutionApproval: Package to a new destination outside this project only when the parent authorizes the next step; then obtain explicit approval before running the reviewed page.

Inspect 1280px and 390px in light and dark themes, including CJK glyphs, long English headings, file text and methods disclosure. Whole-page horizontal overflow must be absent; code may scroll within bounded panels.

Operate runtime English/中文 buttons with pointer and keyboard. Verify initial English, localized title/html lang, hidden inactive branch and excluded inactive focus targets. No competing author language switch exists.

Within each root, activate buttons[data-case='one'|'apart'|'clash'] and compare every [data-code='base'|'ours'|'theirs'|'result'].textContent against v2 fixture bytes, allowing CR and final-newline normalization only.
Check aria-pressed and live feedback without focus relocation. [data-result-state] uses data-state='resolved' or 'conflict' and fully localized visible status.
Check [data-index-stages] appears only on clash; [data-stage-values] exactly equals the three recorded index entries. Verify 1/base/30, 2/ours/60 and 3/theirs/90 explanations.

Follow every individual SVG edge and arrowhead. Verify case hashes and descriptions update; revert annotation appears only for one; [data-merge-node] and both merge edges are hidden on clash, and HEAD remains at ours.
Verify offline operation, console silence, keyboard scrolling of bounded code, focus visibility, reduced-motion behavior and source links without allowing unapproved requests.
Read the rendered complete English and Chinese branches independently and check translation fidelity; record human comprehension feedback only if actually obtained.
